name: NSE India
description: End-of-day data from the National Stock Exchange of India: prices from 2016 (old and UDiFF bhavcopy), delivery %, every index close with India VIX, F&O participant open interest and volume, corporate actions, bulk and block deals, FII/DII cash flows, the listed-equity list and the NIFTY 500 / NIFTY COMMODITIES members with their industry. Reads NSE's public archive and two www.nseindia.com APIs; no settings and no credentials. Uses a plain client and does not work around bot protection.

operations.name: test_connection
operations.description: Read the NSE equity list once

operations.name: validate_config
operations.description: The connection has no settings; always valid

operations.name: discover_schema
operations.description: List the twelve tables and their columns

operations.name: export
operations.description: Export rows from one table: the day walks are incremental by trade_date, corporate_actions by ex_date, the rest are read in full each run

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: One of: bhavcopy_daily, bhavcopy_history, delivery_daily, index_daily, participant_oi_daily, participant_vol_daily, corporate_actions, equity_list, bulk_deals, block_deals, fii_dii_cash, index_constituents

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Row offset for paging (the full-refresh tables only)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page of an incremental table

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Last trade_date (or ex_date) already loaded; an incremental table reads the days after it
